chunks: When it is said to them, 'Do not spread corruption in the land,' they say, 'We are merely reformers.'
ai.seo_question: What do corrupt people say when told to stop causing mischief?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological mechanism of *al-ta'til* (deception) where the corrupt justify their mischief by rebranding it as reform, a trait often attributed to the hypocrites (*Munafiqun*) of Medina. This self-deception serves as a precursor to their eventual expulsion from the community, illustrating how spiritual blindness leads to the distortion of truth for personal or political gain.
